evidence.notes: SYSTEM_MODE is a typed access-mode value used by SOQL and DML to bypass current-user CRUD/FLS checks.
USER_MODE is a typed access-mode value used by SOQL and DML to enforce current-user CRUD/FLS checks.
Dynamic SOQL AccessLevel overload applies USER_MODE and SYSTEM_MODE security semantics.
DML AccessLevel overload applies USER_MODE and SYSTEM_MODE security semantics.

source.content: @isTest private class AccessLevelUserSystemModeTest { @isTest static void userModeEnforcesAndSystemModeBypassesCrudAndFls() { Account seeded = new Account(Name = 'Seeded', Secret__c = 'hidden'); insert seeded; Profile p = [SELECT Id FROM Profile WHERE Name = 'Minimum Access - Salesforce' LIMIT 1]; System.runAs(new User(Id = '00500000000MIN1', ProfileId = p.Id, Username = 'min@example.test')) { Boolean userDmlBlocked = false; try { Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'User DML', Secret__c = 'nope'), AccessLevel.USER_MODE); } catch (SecurityException se) { userDmlBlocked = true; } System.assertEquals(true, userDmlBlocked); Database.SaveResult systemResult = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'System DML', Secret__c = 'ok'), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(true, systemResult.isSuccess()); Boolean userQueryBlocked = false; try { Database.query('SELECT Id, Secret__c FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Seeded\'', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); } catch (QueryException qe) { userQueryBlocked = true; } System.assertEquals(true, userQueryBlocked); List<Account> systemRows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Secret__c FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Seeded\'', AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, systemRows.size()); System.assertEquals('hidden', systemRows[0].Secret__c); } } }
